statement: A legacy-named file that cannot be recognised as a decision record (no parseable `## Context` section -- e.g. hand-written notes in a foreign format) MUST NEVER be treated as a match, even if its filename slug matches exactly.
reason: A file we cannot verify as recording the same (or any) decision is not ours to overwrite. Treating any file with a matching slug as a match risks clobbering a human's hand-written notes that happen to share a filename.
